title: Shadow Experiments — E2E Test Plan (Console + APIs)
body:
Purpose
Validate end-to-end functionality for Shadow Experiments (Console + backend APIs) with emphasis on: (1) experiment creation and lifecycle, (2) correctness and stability of results/deltas, (3) permission boundaries and auditability, and (4) degraded-mode behavior (fail-open, backpressure, scoring lag) without impacting user response path.

Scope
In-scope (beta/GA path):
- Console UI: create experiment, list experiments, detail page (deltas, confidence bands where available), drilldown into sampled examples, export.
- Console backend APIs: CRUD, query aggregates, query examples, filters/pagination.
- Rollouts integration: attaching an experiment to a canary/A-B rollout; linking in rollout timeline.
- RBAC: org/tenant scoping, project/workspace scoping (where applicable), read vs write roles, admin-only actions.
- Audit logs: create/update/delete actions and policy changes.
- Degraded mode: shadow target errors/timeouts, telemetry ingestion lag, scoring queue backlog, circuit breaker triggers; Console behavior under partial data.

Out of scope (explicit non-goals for v1):
- Full offline replay of arbitrary historical traffic beyond retention.
- Customer-managed custom eval code execution inside Redwood.
- Private deployment air-gapped scoring beyond “simulated” tests in this plan.

Test environments / prerequisites
Environments
- staging: primary for E2E automation. Must include routing + shadow mirroring enabled, telemetry ingestion, scoring workers, and dashboards.
- dogfood/internal tenant: for realistic traffic. Use only synthetic prompts approved for storage.
- dedicated-sim: optional environment with tenant-level retention/redaction overrides to validate config knobs.

Feature flags
- shadow_experiments_api: gates API endpoints.
- shadow_experiments_console: gates UI navigation and pages.
- shadow_mirroring_dataplane: gates routing mirroring.
- shadow_scoring_pipeline: gates scoring queue/worker.
Notes: E2E should explicitly cover flag OFF behavior (hidden UI, 404/403 API semantics as decided).

Seed data / fixtures
- Tenant A (internal): roles
  - admin_user (Org Admin)
  - eng_user (Editor/Developer)
  - readonly_user (Viewer)
- Tenant B (external-like): to validate tenant isolation.
- Routes:
  - route_chat_prod (streaming enabled)
  - route_chat_non_stream (non-stream)
  - route_embeddings (should be blocked for v1 if not supported; validate correct UX/error)
- Variants:
  - control: model=rw-open-llama-70b:v3, quant=fp16
  - shadow1: model=rw-open-llama-70b:v4, quant=fp16
  - shadow2: model=rw-open-llama-70b:v3, quant=int8 (quantization profile variant)
- Prompt corpus: synthetic, non-sensitive; include intentional “format contract” tasks (JSON schema output), refusal/safety prompts, and instruction-following prompts.

Observability hooks required for E2E
- Ability to query scoring lag (p50/p95) and ingestion lag in test env.
- Ability to force/simulate:
  - shadow target 5xx
  - shadow target timeout
  - ingestion throttling
  - scoring worker pause
  - circuit breaker open
(If we lack toggles, coordinate with SRE/Platform to add test-only knobs.)

Pass/Fail criteria
- Pass: all P0 scenarios pass; no P0 regressions; no evidence of user-path latency impact in staging canary run (measured via existing route latency metrics) when shadowing is enabled at <=1% sampling.
- Fail: any P0 scenario fails; any cross-tenant data leakage; any role bypass; any case where enabling shadowing changes the user response payload; any audit log omissions for create/update/delete.

Risk areas / known sharp edges (track during QA)
- Cardinality: example drilldown filters might introduce high-cardinality dimensions; ensure backend does not emit unsafe labels.
- Partial data windows: scoring results are async; deltas should show “insufficient data” not misleading zeros.
- Streaming semantics: mirrored streaming requests may be partial; ensure UI explains partial capture and scoring eligibility.
- Retention/redaction: example payloads must be redacted/truncated per policy; ensure UI never displays raw prompt when redaction applied.

Test matrix
Legend: P0 = must pass for beta; P1 = should pass before GA; P2 = nice-to-have.

A) Experiment creation flow (Console)
A1 (P0) Create experiment — minimal valid fields
- Preconditions: shadow_experiments_console=ON; user=admin_user; route_chat_non_stream exists.
- Steps:
  1) Navigate: Console → Rollouts/Quality → Shadow Experiments → Create.
  2) Select route=route_chat_non_stream.
  3) Set sampling=1%.
  4) Add 1 shadow target: shadow1.
  5) Save.
- Expected:
  - Experiment created with status=Active (or Created→Active depending on lifecycle).
  - UI shows experiment ID, created timestamp, owner.
  - A “data pending” state is shown until results present.
  - No client-side console errors.

A2 (P0) Validation errors and inline guidance
- Steps:
  - Try sampling=0, sampling>max allowed, missing route, duplicate shadow targets.
- Expected:
  - Clear error messages.
  - Save disabled until valid.
  - Matches backend validation errors (no divergence between UI and API).

A3 (P1) Create experiment with multiple shadow targets (fan-out)
- Steps:
  - Add shadow1 + shadow2; set per-target timeout if supported.
- Expected:
  - Experiment saves and UI clearly lists both targets.
  - Later results show per-target deltas.

A4 (P1) Create experiment from a Rollout (attach)
- Preconditions: existing canary rollout object for route_chat_non_stream.
- Steps:
  - Rollout detail page → “Attach shadow experiment” → create new.
- Expected:
  - Experiment linked in rollout timeline.
  - Clicking link opens experiment detail with context back-link.

A5 (P1) Idempotency/duplicate submit
- Steps:
  - Click Save repeatedly / refresh during save.
- Expected:
  - Exactly one experiment created.
  - UI recovers gracefully and navigates to created experiment.

B) Experiment lifecycle operations (Console + API)
B1 (P0) Pause/Resume experiment
- Preconditions: experiment active.
- Steps:
  - Pause; confirm; then Resume.
- Expected:
  - Status transitions reflected in UI and API.
  - Mirroring stops/starts accordingly (validated via event counts not increasing while paused).

B2 (P0) Update sampling rate
- Steps:
  - Change sampling 1% → 5%.
- Expected:
  - Audit log entry created.
  - Backend enforces max sampling per tenant.
  - UI warns about cost/overhead.

B3 (P1) Update shadow target set
- Steps:
  - Add/remove a shadow target.
- Expected:
  - New target appears; old target retains historical results (if supported) or clearly resets.
  - UI indicates boundary (“configuration changed at T”).

B4 (P0) Delete experiment
- Steps:
  - Delete; confirm.
- Expected:
  - Experiment no longer listed.
  - API returns 404 (or tombstone) depending on decision; ensure consistent.
  - Audit log entry present.

C) API contract E2E (Console backend)
C1 (P0) Create experiment API
- Endpoint: POST /shadow-experiments
- Validate:
  - 201 with experiment_id
  - server-side validation errors are stable and documented
  - feature flag OFF => 404 or 403 per spec (verify)

C2 (P0) List experiments API with pagination
- Endpoint: GET /shadow-experiments?page_size=…&cursor=…
- Expected:
  - Stable ordering (by created_at desc)
  - Cursor roundtrips; no duplicates

C3 (P0) Get aggregates API
- Endpoint: GET /shadow-experiments/{id}/aggregates?window=1h|24h
- Expected:
  - Returns control vs shadow metrics with explicit “n” sample sizes
  - If insufficient data: explicit state, not zeros
  - No high-cardinality fields present (no raw prompt_id unless hashed/allowed)

C4 (P1) Get examples API with filters
- Endpoint: GET /shadow-experiments/{id}/examples?outcome=regression|improvement&limit=…
- Expected:
  - Examples are redacted/truncated
  - PII-safe fields only
  - RBAC enforced (see section D)

C5 (P1) Export API (if present in beta)
- Endpoint: GET /shadow-experiments/{id}/export
- Expected:
  - Export contains only allowed fields; respects retention window

D) Permissions, RBAC, and tenant isolation
D1 (P0) Role-based access — Viewer
- Preconditions: readonly_user has Viewer role.
- Expected:
  - Can view list + detail + aggregates.
  - Cannot create/update/pause/delete.
  - UI hides write actions AND API returns 403 if called.

D2 (P0) Role-based access — Editor/Developer
- Preconditions: eng_user (Editor).
- Expected:
  - Can create/pause/resume/update sampling.
  - Delete restricted to Admin (if that’s the policy) OR validated against the chosen policy.

D3 (P0) Admin-only retention/redaction overrides (if exposed)
- Expected:
  - Non-admin cannot change retention/export settings.

D4 (P0) Tenant isolation
- Steps:
  - Using Tenant A credentials, attempt to access Tenant B experiment ID.
- Expected:
  - 404 (preferred) or 403 per security policy.
  - No metadata leakage (title, existence, timestamps).

D5 (P0) Audit logs
- Validate audit entries for:
  - create experiment
  - update config (sampling, targets)
  - pause/resume
  - delete
- Expected fields:
  - actor, tenant, timestamp, action, resource_id, diff summary.
- Note: confirm entries appear in audit log UI and via audit export path (if available in env).

E) Results correctness and statistical sanity checks
Goal: verify that what we render in the Console matches the underlying scoring outputs and aggregation logic, and that we handle async timing without misleading users.

E1 (P0) Control response unaffected
- Method:
  - Run baseline request to route_chat_non_stream with shadow enabled.
  - Compare response payload to shadow disabled (same input, same control model pinned).
- Expected:
  - Identical control output (within expected nondeterminism bounds if temp>0; for test set use temp=0).
  - No added latency beyond acceptable jitter; shadow failures do not bubble to user.

E2 (P0) Aggregates reflect known synthetic regression
- Setup:
  - Use a prompt set where shadow2 (int8) is known to occasionally violate JSON format.
- Steps:
  - Run enough synthetic traffic (or replay job) to exceed minimum sample size.
- Expected:
  - Format adherence metric decreases for shadow2 vs control.
  - UI flags regression (color/label) and shows sample size and time window.
  - Confidence interval shown only when computed; otherwise show “CI unavailable” not fake bounds.

E3 (P1) Metric version/rubric version pinning displayed
- Steps:
  - Run experiment across a rubric version bump (if possible in staging) or simulate by creating experiment pinned to v0 vs v1.
- Expected:
  - UI displays rubric version used.
  - Aggregates are not compared across incompatible versions without explicit warning.

E4 (P1) Example drilldown matches aggregate counts
- Steps:
  - Filter examples by “format_violation=true”; count returned examples should be consistent with aggregate rate (within sampling limits).
- Expected:
  - No examples outside retention window.
  - Example payloads show redaction markers.

E5 (P2) Segment filters
- If segmentation by region/model-route exists:
  - Validate that segment filters do not explode cardinality; UI uses allowed enums/buckets.

F) Degraded-mode behavior (must be boring)
F1 (P0) Shadow target timeout (data plane)
- Steps:
  - Force shadow target to time out (e.g., firewall rule or test knob).
  - Send production-like traffic.
- Expected:
  - User response path succeeds.
  - Telemetry indicates shadow_error=timeout.
  - UI shows increased shadow error rate; no crash.

F2 (P0) Shadow target 5xx
- Expected:
  - Same as timeout; no retries that impact user path.

F3 (P0) Telemetry ingestion lag
- Steps:
  - Throttle ingestion (test knob) so events arrive late.
- Expected:
  - UI shows “data delayed” banner with last ingested timestamp.
  - Aggregates window queries are explicit about data completeness.

F4 (P0) Scoring queue backlog
- Steps:
  - Pause scoring workers; generate shadow events.
- Expected:
  - UI shows scoring lag increasing.
  - No false “quality is stable” conclusions; should show “pending scoring”.
  - When workers resume, metrics backfill; UI updates.

F5 (P0) Circuit breaker open
- Steps:
  - Induce sustained shadow failures to trigger breaker.
- Expected:
  - Mirroring disables automatically (or reduces) per policy.
  - User path unaffected.
  - UI surfaces breaker state and guidance (“shadowing temporarily disabled due to errors”).

F6 (P1) Partial outages: examples endpoint unavailable
- Steps:
  - Simulate examples storage outage while aggregates still work.
- Expected:
  - Detail page loads aggregates; examples panel shows error + retry; no full page failure.

F7 (P1) Rate limiting / quotas
- Steps:
  - Exceed allowable example fetch or export limits.
- Expected:
  - Proper 429 and UI message; no infinite spinners.

G) Streaming-specific E2E
G1 (P0) Streaming request mirrored without user-visible changes
- Steps:
  - Use route_chat_prod with streaming.
- Expected:
  - Streaming chunks delivered identically with and without shadowing.
  - Shadow capture rules honored (partial capture allowed but must be flagged).

G2 (P1) Shadow streaming stops early
- Steps:
  - Force shadow target to be slow mid-stream.
- Expected:
  - User stream continues.
  - Shadow stream may be terminated at timeout; recorded as partial.
  - Scoring either skips partials or uses partial policy; UI indicates.

H) Redaction/retention and sensitive data handling
H1 (P0) Redaction applied before display
- Steps:
  - Include synthetic prompt containing a redaction trigger pattern.
- Expected:
  - Stored/displayed prompt is redacted per rules.
  - UI indicates redaction occurred.

H2 (P1) Retention window enforced
- Steps:
  - Set retention short in dedicated-sim; wait/advance time if tooling allows.
- Expected:
  - Examples older than retention not retrievable.
  - Aggregates may remain (if aggregates retained separately); ensure it matches policy.

I) Regression tests / compatibility
I1 (P0) Backwards compatibility on existing Rollouts UI
- Ensure Shadow Experiments nav and components do not break existing latency/cost rollout dashboards.

I2 (P1) Browser compatibility
- Validate Chrome + Firefox latest; Safari best-effort.

I3 (P1) API versioning
- If API is versioned, ensure old clients get sane errors; SDK behavior aligned.

Automation plan
- Cypress/Playwright for UI flows (A, B, D, partial E).
- API tests (Postman/newman or pytest) for C, D, F.
- Load test (small) for “user-path unaffected”: run 1–5% shadow sampling and compare p50/p95/p99 vs baseline; store results as CI artifact.
- Scheduled nightly: degraded mode F3/F4 (can be flaky; mark as quarantine until test knobs stable).

Test data management
- Do not use real production prompts.
- For dogfood tests: ensure “prompt logging for shadow artifacts” is set to minimal retention; confirm redaction.
- Ensure all screenshots/log exports used in bug reports redact any payloads.

Bug triage and severity definitions
- Sev0: user response changed or user-path errors increased due to shadowing.
- Sev1: cross-tenant data access, RBAC bypass, missing audit logs.
- Sev2: incorrect aggregates/deltas, misleading UI states, export leaks.
- Sev3: cosmetic issues, copy, minor UI alignment.

Open questions / items blocking final sign-off
- Final policy: who can delete experiments (Admin only vs Editor)? Need explicit decision so tests align.
- Feature flag OFF semantics: 404 vs 403 (security preference is 404 to avoid discovery).
- Minimum sample sizes for “regression” labeling (Applied ML to provide thresholds); otherwise use “insufficient data” gating.
- Streaming partial scoring policy: skip vs score-partial; UI copy depends.

Owners for follow-ups
- Test knobs for degraded-mode simulation: Sean Gallagher / Platform SRE.
- Rubric version display and compatibility behavior: Jonas Weber / Selene Huang.
- RBAC policy confirmation + audit log fields: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei.
- UI copy for “data delayed/pending scoring”: Kenji Nakamura + Elliot Price.

Change log
- 2026-02-10: Added degraded-mode tests for scoring backlog + ingestion lag after dogfood queue incident.
- 2026-02-18: Added streaming-specific cases based on routing semantics review.
- 2026-02-24: Updated RBAC test expectations to match latest Console backend checks (pending final policy decision on delete).
